products.overview: NIR-II probes can emit beyond the visible and near-infrared ranges used by conventional fluorescence systems. To validate these probes properly, researchers need more than a single detection wavelength. They need access to the fluorescence spectrum across the relevant infrared region.
features: 900–1600 nm NIR-II Fluorescence Detection: ClaIR™ captures full fluorescence spectra from 900 to 1600 nm, covering the NIR-II region used for characterization of infrared-emitting probes and materials.
500–1600 nm Absorbance Spectroscopy: The system extends absorbance measurements from the visible into the infrared using a halogen white lamp.
High-Sensitivity VIS and IR Spectrometer: A high-sensitivity VIS and IR spectrometer provides the detection platform for fluorescence and infrared spectral measurements.
650 nm and 735 nm Laser Excitation: Built-in 650 nm and 735 nm laser diodes provide defined excitation wavelengths for fluorescence measurements.
Optional Tunable Light Source: A fiber entry allows an optional tunable light source to be integrated when the required excitation wavelength extends beyond the built-in laser sources.
96-Well Microplate Format: ClaIR™ supports standardized 96-well plates complying with ANSI/SLAS 1-2004 through 6-2012.
Adjustable Focal Height: Focal height can be adjusted with a resolution of 0.1 mm to support different measurement positions within the well.
Adjustable Read Height: The read height can be adjusted from the bottom to the middle of the well.
Fluorescence and Absorbance Modes: ClaIR™ supports both absorbance and fluorescence spectroscopy, giving researchers access to two measurement modes within one microplate platform.
CSV Data Output: Measurement data can be exported in CSV format for analysis and reporting.
USB Computer Interface: USB connectivity provides the computer interface for system operation and data handling.

longForm.heroHook: Capture Full NIR-II Fluorescence Spectra from 900 to 1600 nm
longForm.heroLead: NIR-II probes can emit beyond the visible and near-infrared ranges used by conventional fluorescence systems. To validate these probes properly, researchers need more than a single detection wavelength. They need access to the fluorescence spectrum across the relevant infrared region. Photon etc. ClaIR™ is a NIR-II infrared microplate reader designed to capture full fluorescence spectra from 900 to 1600 nm in a 96-well plate format. It combines laser-based fluorescence excitation with a high-sensitivity VIS and IR spectrometer for spectral characterization of infrared-emitting probes and materials. ClaIR™ supports both fluorescence and absorbance spectroscopy. Fluorescence measurements use 650 nm and 735 nm laser diodes, while an optional tunable light source can be connected through the integrated fiber entry. Absorbance measurements cover 500 to 1600 nm using a halogen white lamp. With ANSI/SLAS-compliant 96-well plate compatibility, adjustable focal height, USB connectivity, and CSV data output, ClaIR™ brings NIR-II spectral analysis into a standardized microplate workflow.

sections.title: Why NIR-II Detection Matters
body: NIR-II fluorescence measurements require detection in a wavelength region that extends beyond conventional visible fluorescence. When a probe's emission lies in the infrared, measuring only at a selected wavelength can limit the information available about its spectral behaviour.
ClaIR™ is designed to capture fluorescence spectra from 900 to 1600 nm, allowing researchers to examine the emission profile across the NIR-II region supported by the system.

This is particularly relevant for researchers developing or characterizing NIR-II fluorescent probes, infrared-emitting materials, and nanomaterials where the spectral position and shape of the emission are important research parameters.
The system also supports absorbance measurements from 500 to 1600 nm, extending spectral characterization from the visible into the infrared.
